propositions: Repository-effective project LLM criteria must be injected exactly once into round_a and never into round_b, with each project finding retaining its logical criterion id in the project namespace.
The repository-scoped effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for the logical project id in Pass 3.
A project code-review id active in exactly one gate resolves and calibrates through the code-review arm of criteria eval; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
An activated project criterion with missing or invalid prompt/eval specification raises a located configuration error rather than silently falling back.

The normative runtime contract must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with four required subheadings: Round A/B fan-in, Effective routing in Pass 3, criteria eval resolution, and Configuration error.
